key_highlights: ASX slides as rising oil prices fuel RBA rate-hike bets; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) fall on margin compression fears
RBA deputy governor signals inflation remains too high, raising odds of a September/October rate hike
Iron ore in sustained downtrend; BHP under severe pressure as commodity price 'crumbles'
Hormuz Strait escalation drives oil higher, pressuring global equities and lifting energy names
Gold miners (Forrestania, Kaiser, Larvotto, Aureka) see strong M&A and discovery activity amid safe-haven demand
Australian property sector faces 'GFC moment' as mortgage costs push households into second jobs
Santos under fire as gas cartel dynamics shift; energy sector in flux
Qantas (QAN.AX) issues $35M redundancy payout, signalling ongoing structural cost pressure

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP, RIO, FMG under heavy pressure. Gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows and strong M&A activity (Forrestania 2Moz, Kaiser Tassie, Larvotto NSW, Aureka $8.9M Victorian deal). Uranium exploration (Infini) active.
sectors.implications: Rotate out of iron ore exposure; overweight gold and uranium juniors. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face further downside if ore prices stay weak. GSG.AX, GWN.AX, FOR.AX, KAL.AX, LRV.AX, ARK.AX benefit.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as rising oil fuels rate-hike expectations, compressing net interest margins and raising credit-risk concerns. RBA deputy governor's inflation commentary adds hawkish pressure. Qantas $35M payout signals broader corporate stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face near-term headwinds. Watch for RBA September decision. Insurance and diversified financials may outperform.

sectors.trend: Hormuz Strait escalation lifts oil prices; Germany gas shortage risk adds to supply concerns. Santos under scrutiny as gas cartel dynamics break. Rising energy costs feed into inflation, complicating RBA path.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, XTL.AX benefit from higher oil/gas prices but face political and regulatory risk. Energy is a key inflation driver for RBA policy.

sectors.trend: Property industry faces 'GFC moment'; NZ house price crash returns; mortgage costs driving households to second jobs. Construction capacity constrained ('Australia has lost the ability to build').
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) under pressure from higher rates and demand softening. Construction names (WBC.AX, CGW.AX) face supply-side constraints.

sectors.trend: Household stress intensifies: second jobs, mortgage pressure, car supply crunch raising insurance premiums. Global consumer weakness (Gap 350 store closures, beverage brand Chapter 11). Tobacco tax debate in AU politics.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSG.AX offer relative defensiveness. Auto and discretionary names under pressure. Tobacco (BAT, Lory) faces regulatory headwinds.

sectors.trend: No major sector-specific headlines today. ATO vs Big Tech tax dispute may affect tech valuations. CSL remains a defensive anchor.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SVL.AX, WES.AX (health) provide portfolio ballast. Tech exposure limited on ASX; monitor ATO enforcement actions.

key_themes: RBA hawkish tilt: inflation sticky, rate-hike risk elevated
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 20 heavyweights
Geopolitical oil shock via Hormuz Strait
Gold as safe-haven: strong M&A and discovery pipeline
Australian household balance-sheet stress and property fragility
US political risk (Trump threats, midterms) spilling into global risk appetite
Energy transition: gas cartel break, Santos political exposure

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour fixed-income and dividend payers with pricing power
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and uranium miners
Hedge with energy equities (SOL.AX, XTL.AX) or oil-linked ETFs; monitor AUD/USD for sharp moves
Limit REIT and construction exposure; monitor mortgage arrears and housing starts data
Diversify geographically; hold AUD-hedged international exposure; monitor Canada-US trade tensions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Santos / gas sector regulatory and political risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor government energy policy; diversify energy exposure beyond single-name Santos risk

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven demand and strong M&A pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser Tassie expansion, Larvotto NSW discovery, Aureka $8.9M Victorian acquisition signal sector strength; gold price supported by geopolitical risk and Trump uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long energy on Hormuz-driven oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz escalation and German gas shortage risk support oil/gas prices; SOL.AX and XTL.AX benefit from higher realisation prices

opportunities.recommendation: Uranium exploration exposure on supply tightness
opportunities.rationale: Infini 7.5% uranium target in Canada signals renewed exploration interest; nuclear renaissance theme

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and heavy materials exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; BHP under existential pressure; commodity 'drowning not waving'

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and property-linked positions ahead of potential RBA hike
defensive_moves.rationale: Property 'GFC moment', NZ crash, household stress; rate hike would pressure valuations further

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bonds as hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Elevated geopolitical and policy uncertainty; CD rates up to 4.35% APY offer attractive yield

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. RBA hawkish tone, oil-driven inflation, and iron ore weakness cap upside. Banks and materials drag index. Gold and energy provide selective pockets of strength. Expect volatility around RBA September decision and Hormuz developments.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots and iron ore stabilises. Gold, uranium, and healthcare offer structural tailwinds. Property and consumer remain vulnerable. US midterms and Trump policy risk add uncertainty. Australian construction capacity gap is a multi-year constraint.

Iron ore price trajectory (BHP, RIO, FMG earnings)

Australian CPI and employment data (household stress indicators)

AUD/USD reaction to yen carry-trade unwind

Brent crude and Hormuz Strait shipping status
Gold spot price and ASX gold miner M&A activity
Australian mortgage arrears and housing starts
US midterm election schedule and policy signals
ATO enforcement actions against Big Tech
